newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO PESO PARES GAINS ON U.S. LONG BOND.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO PESO PARES GAINS ON U.S. LONG BOND.

text.p: The Mexican peso moderated its earlier strength after tracking weakness in the U.S. long bond, dealers said.
"Market perception is there could be some over-spill via long bond yields from U.S. inflation data later in the week," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were both 1.0 centavo firmer at 7.8060/7.8100 and 7.8040/7.8070 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 1.3 centavos weaker at 7.8010/7.8040 per dollar.
U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds were meanwhile down 9/32 to yield 6.66 percent.
